CancellationData.description: What cancellation does to data (R20, R54).

delete.description: Optional data the customer opted into; deleted now.

retain_records_until.description: Policy, premium, claims, ledger and offer records are kept, access-restricted, until then.

DeclaredItem.description: Something the customer declared, with its declared value when given.

kind.description: A registered declared item kind (`config/exposure_types.yaml`), such as `device.phone`.

Money.description: Money in minor units (cents). No floating point in money paths (R29).

Profile.description:
What the engine may know about a customer. No protected attributes here (R19); industry
rating attributes (age, gender, district) arrive only through `optimiser::RatingInputs`,
which never reaches the AI layer.

consents.description: Registered optional data types the customer opted into (`config/data_types.yaml`, R20).

language.description:
The customer's language setting, one of the insurer's `languages.offered`; none means
the market default.

work_areas.description:
Registered areas (a district, county or city) where the declared hours are worked, for a
trigger reported per area (R55, ADR-012). The insured location: never an AI input (R19).

UpcomingEvent.description: A known future event, for example a concert in three months.

kind.description: A registered upcoming event kind (`config/exposure_types.yaml`), such as `event.concert`.

value.description: Ticket price or booked cost, when declared.

WorkWindow.description:
A declared working window in market local time (R08). `weekday` is ISO: 1 = Monday to
7 = Sunday. Minutes count from local midnight; an `end_minute` at or before `start_minute`
runs past midnight into the next day (a night shift), and the shift belongs to the day it
starts.

description: The customer as the store keeps them: their declarations and opt-ins, and how they came.

cancelled.description: Set on cancellation: optional data deleted, records kept until a date (R54).

partner_id.description: The partner whose channel they first came through (R52).

title: CustomerRecord
